card.title: Authority on Paper
card.instruction: Project firm control through titles and procedure, then tighten the formalities whenever anyone tests whether your position has real support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm chairing this meeting under the emergency neighbourhood charter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are only two of us, and I haven't agreed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll record your objection before proceeding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A vote to recognise my authority to record objections.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims emergency chair authority, A3 records dissent, and A5 proposes a self-authorizing vote, but there is little concrete business behind the meeting.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges the two-person meeting's legitimacy and B4 seeks its actual purpose.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's question to add a vote, but does not clearly tighten an existing challenge process around a practical task.
